'''Thei's husband''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Newcomer]] who worked as a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. He was the husband of [[Thei]], a woman who needed help from [[Theran Listener]].
